correctness.rationale: For the ordered matching on nonempty faces, any directed cycle must alternate up and down: consecutive upward edges cannot occur in a matching, and the numbers of upward and downward steps around a cycle are equal. Thus every cycle cell survived all stages before the minimum-index upward toggle on the cycle. For that index, a downward toggle is impossible: its two endpoints would have been paired at that stage. This justifies the acyclicity argument. After toggling z, the only remaining z-face is {z}. For faces without z, the independence number is ∑A_j; adding z replaces this by max(∑A_j,1+∑B_j). A face remains exactly when A_j=B_j for all j and the sum is k−1. A residual cover cannot change this rank vector. Independently enumerated the 32 local subsets by testing every independent subsubset according to adjacency in the five-path; the qualifying strata have sizes 1,7,7, and successive toggles leave exactly ∅, de, bcde. On each product stratum, the blockwise greedy matching removes the entire earlier-coordinate pair times every later-coordinate choice, so the sole survivor is the product of local survivors. The empty face never consumes {z}. The Morse CW model has one point and cells only in dimension 2k−3, with multiplicity [t^(k−1)](1+t+t²)^m; their attaching maps are constant. This gives the wedge and the null case, including k=2m+2. Inspected frozen checker and verification scope without executing that checker.
residual_risks: The independent finite census checked the local table, not all 16 recorded large finite checks. The integral conclusion rests on the reconstructed uniform matching proof.

The uniform integral homotopy formula identifies precisely those thresholds and ranks and explains the trinomial rather than merely counting faces.
